title: Broadcom CEO says biggest hurdle in AI-fuelled tech growth is capital, not memory chips
source_used: Yahoo Finance (carrying Reuters' text; Reuters page returned HTTP 401)
key_facts: Broadcom chief executive Hock Tan said on Monday 12 Oct 2026 that capital will be the biggest constraint facing the company as AI development continues.
He spoke at a panel in Singapore.
He said Broadcom is overcoming wafer shortages and memory shortages, but that capital will be the biggest constraint.
He added that the frontier labs Anthropic and OpenAI have shown they can generate significant revenue from the latest models deployed for AI personal assistants.
The Reuters text is a short bulletin with no figures.
quote_evidence: SINGAPORE, Oct 12 (Reuters) - Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said on Monday that capital will be the biggest constraint facing the company as AI development continues.
At a panel in Singapore on Monday, Tan said that the company is overcoming wafer shortages and memory shortages, but capital will be the biggest constraint
He added that frontier labs Anthropic and OpenAI have shown that they can generate significant revenue from the latest models that have been deployed for AI personal assistants
why_it_matters_hint: A leading chip maker's chief says money, not parts, is now the main limit on his company's AI business.
notes: Reuters original blocked (401); read the Reuters bulletin on Yahoo Finance (credited Reuters, reporting by Jun Yuan Yong). The pool headline widens the claim to all AI-fuelled tech growth; the text says the biggest constraint facing the company.
